tldr: 台股10月6日漲110.51點收49,822.55點，叩關5萬點失利，台積電續創歷史新高。
工研院估2026台灣半導體產值破7.13兆元，全球AI伺服器出貨衝上450萬台。
金管會持續深化亞洲資產管理中心，高雄專區累計57家業者進駐。

items.title_zh: 台股叩關5萬點失利 台積電領軍收斂漲勢
items.title_en: TAIEX stalls just below 50,000 as TSMC leads late profit-taking
items.summary_zh: 加權指數10月6日上漲110.51點、漲幅0.22%，收在49,822.55點，成交量約9,759億元。盤中一度衝高至約49,968點，距5萬點整數關卡僅約32點，隨後半導體權值股走弱，漲勢收斂。台積電終場上漲10元、收2,585元，撐住指數維持高檔，市場屏息等待即將登場的財報季。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index rose 110.51 points, or 0.22%, to close at 49,822.55 on Oct 6, with turnover of about NT$975.9bn. The market briefly climbed to roughly 49,968 intraday, within about 32 points of the 50,000 mark, before heavyweight semiconductors softened and trimmed the advance. TSMC ended up NT$10 at NT$2,585, keeping the index near record territory ahead of the coming earnings season.

items.title_zh: 台積電市值達66.77兆 一檔貢獻594點
items.title_en: TSMC market value tops NT$66.77tn, driving a fresh batch of records
items.summary_zh: 台積電10月6日創下多項紀錄，市值約達66.77兆元，單一個股即貢獻指數約594點。AI加速器帶動的先進製程產能需求持續強勁，支撐台積電股價維持高檔；由於權值占比龐大，大盤走勢高度連動台積電，投資人提前布局第3季財報行情。
items.summary_en: TSMC set multiple records on Oct 6, with market capitalisation reaching about NT$66.77tn and the stock single-handedly contributing roughly 594 points to the index. Sustained demand for advanced-node capacity tied to AI accelerators continues to underpin the chipmaker, whose weighting leaves the broader TAIEX closely tracking its moves as investors position for the Q3 results.

items.title_zh: 工研院估2026半導體產值破7兆 AI伺服器衝450萬台
items.title_en: ITRI sees 2026 chip output above NT$7tn, AI servers at 4.5 million units
items.summary_zh: 工研院與資策會MIC預估，台灣2026年半導體產值將突破7.13兆元、年增約10%，其中IC製造受惠3奈米滿載與2奈米放量，動能最強。全球AI伺服器出貨預估達450萬台、滲透率近三成，帶動先進製程產能連續四年成長逾四成，確立台灣在AI供應鏈的核心地位。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute and the MIC forecast the island's 2026 semiconductor output value will exceed NT$7.13tn, up about 10% on the year, led by IC manufacturing as 3nm runs full and 2nm ramps. Global AI-server shipments are projected to reach 4.5 million units with penetration near 30%, sustaining four straight years of 40%-plus growth in advanced-process capacity.

items.title_zh: 台廠AI動能不墜 主要IT廠營收連29個月增長
items.title_en: Taiwan's major IT makers extend record revenue streak on AI demand
items.summary_zh: 台灣主要IT廠（含台積電、鴻海等）營收連續第29個月成長，7月合計營收年增逾五成、突破2兆元，為史上數一數二的單月增幅。強勁表現反映AI伺服器與先進晶片需求持續暢旺，市場預期供應鏈動能可望延續至年底，產業基本面維持穩健。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's leading IT manufacturers, including TSMC and Hon Hai, logged a 29th straight month of revenue growth, with July combined revenue jumping more than 50% year on year and topping NT$2tn, among the largest monthly gains on record. The surge reflects relentless AI-server and advanced-chip demand, reinforcing expectations that the supply chain will stay busy through year-end.

items.title_zh: 金管會新增三大試辦 將發布「金融大回饋指引」
items.title_en: FSC adds three pilot schemes, plans a "financial giveback" guideline
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆宣布為深化亞洲資產管理中心，新增「跨境服務」、「99人限制鬆綁」及「預繳保費帳戶」三大試辦項目，並將發布「金融大回饋指引」。截至4月底，相關政策已累計完成52項法規調適，金融業資產管理規模較2024年中增加10.62兆元，顯示資產管理制度逐步鬆綁與擴大。
items.summary_en: Financial Supervisory Commission chair Peng Jin-lung announced new pilots to deepen the Asian Asset Management Centre, including cross-border services, relaxing the 99-investor cap and prepaid-premium accounts, alongside a forthcoming "financial giveback" guideline. By end-April the policy had completed 52 regulatory adjustments, with industry assets under management up NT$10.62tn since mid-2024, signalling a steady widening of Taiwan's wealth-management framework.

items.title_zh: 金融三業2025稅前賺9880億 史上次高
items.title_en: Taiwan's financial trio booked NT$988bn pre-tax profit in 2025, second-highest ever
items.summary_zh: 金管會統計，2025年銀行、保險、證券三業稅前盈餘合計約9,880億元，為史上次高。銀行業以6,279億元居冠、年增約11%；保險業1,937億元、年減約43%，主因提列外匯價格變動準備金。主管機關重申「安全與發展並進」，在推動制度革新的同時兼顧金融穩定與風險控管。
items.summary_en: The banking, insurance and securities sectors posted combined pre-tax earnings of about NT$988bn in 2025, the second-highest on record. Banks led with NT$627.9bn, up about 11% year on year, while insurers' NT$193.7bn fell roughly 43% as firms set aside foreign-exchange volatility reserves. Regulators reiterated a balance of safety and development as the framework evolves.

items.title_zh: 台灣超高資產人數創高 配置偏向境外與月配息
items.title_en: Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth ranks hit a record, tilting to offshore assets
items.summary_zh: 依中國信託《2026台灣超高資產客群報告》，2025年淨資產逾新台幣1億元者約12.3萬人，較2021年增加1.7萬人。超高資產客戶中74%持有境外資產，資產逾10億元者更高達86%。核心配置以股票型基金為主，偏好台股與科技類股；債券則鍾情新興市場債與月配息級別，呈現分散與收益並重的趨勢。
items.summary_en: CTBC's 2026 wealth report says the number of people with net assets above NT$100mn reached about 123,000 in 2025, up 17,000 from 2021. Some 74% of ultra-high-net-worth clients hold offshore assets, rising to 86% for those above NT$1bn. Core allocations centre on equity funds, especially Taiwan and tech names, with bonds favouring emerging-market and monthly-distribution tranches.

items.title_zh: 台新打造高資產財富管理平台 進駐高雄專區
items.title_en: Taishin builds a high-net-worth platform for the Kaohsiung asset hub
items.summary_zh: 台新銀行表示，為響應亞洲資產管理中心政策，攜手集團台新銀行、台新證券、台新投信及新光人壽共同進駐高雄資產管理專區，打造整合型高資產財富管理平台。透過跨子公司協作與集團資源整合，深化對高資產客群的信託、傳承與境外資產配置服務，呼應金融業搶進財富管理版圖的趨勢。
items.summary_en: Taishin Bank said it is answering the Asian Asset Management Centre policy by teaming up across the group — Taishin Bank, Taishin Securities, Taishin Investment Trust and Shin Kong Life — to enter the Kaohsiung special zone and build an integrated high-net-worth wealth-management platform. The move leverages cross-subsidiary collaboration to serve affluent clients, part of a broader push by banks and insurers into trust, succession and offshore-focused services.
